rv.q: The comedy is also packed with references to modern pop culture and memes, from ‘6-7’ to the Jet2 holiday advert jingle to Jack trading away his cow for a 24 carat gold Labubu, but it manages to feel self-deprecatingly funny rather than cringe-worthy.
The story however is of secondary importance. It’s really just a framework for a series of set-piece slap-stick and wordplay gags and, as this is big budget panto, for spectacle.
